documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara manufacturing facility. Management reported strong revenue and PAT growth for both the fourth quarter and the full year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and the transition toward in-house manufacturing. The company outlined priorities for FY2027, including scaling manufacturing utilization to full capacity, increasing the contribution of manufacturing to 50% of the revenue mix, and expanding binder sales into non-textile industries. Furthermore, management noted that internal accruals and strong cash flows will support debt reduction without major new capex constraints. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for the fourth quarter and full year of fiscal 2026, highlighting growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax.

guidance.claim: Management expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve a revenue contribution split of 50% from manufacturing and 50% from trading.
guidance.quote: The more we reduce trading, we can be more independent in manufacturing and the entire purpose is to be independent, so we want to focus more on the manufacturing.

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA margins can increase by 200 to 300 basis points upon full capacity utilization.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points.

guidance.claim: Manufacturing revenue for the current year is expected to be around INR60 crores to INR70 crores.
The company expects to close the full year with a top line of around INR 110 crores.
guidance.quote:
Prateek Chaudhary: Sir, in our last con call, we had said that this year we would close around INR110 crores. So are you still maintaining that guidance or has something changed?
Tushar Sanghavi: No, of course the same.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted improving demand trends in the wood coating segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The recently signed India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: Bangladesh is facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production costs, and stricter compliance requirements, leading India to emerge as a preferred sourcing destination.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the textile market is expected to be 15% to 20%, while the wood coating market is anticipated to grow by 20% to 30%.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara facility is spread over 10 acres of land with a 72,000 square feet automated setup and an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: New machinery is being added over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has further scope to expand manufacturing capacity by putting up additional vessels costing INR3 crores to INR5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production commenced at the company's first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, featuring an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The manufacturing facility was built with utilities, cooling plants, and monomer storage already installed for future expansions without requiring additional high capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Ryan. We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

capex_expansion.claim: Out of the INR 50 crores manufacturing capex, INR 30 crores was funded through a bank loan, INR 10 crores through IPO proceeds for land purchase, and the remaining amount from internal accruals and unsecured promoter loans.
capex_expansion.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have remained volatile, with raw materials seeing a sharp increase driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margins for the manufacturing segment are around 20% to 25%, while the trading business is 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The transition to a manufacturing-led model aims to strengthen margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility.
margins_costs.quote: Transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model, strengthening margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for Q4 FY26 was reported at 1,296.4 lacs with a gross profit margin of 33.2%.
Q3 FY26 revenue reached INR 33.54 crores, growing by 5.38% year-on-year, while EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR 7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: In quarter 3 financial year '26, the company reported a revenue of INR33.54 crores, growing by 5.38% year-on-year. On a quarter-on-quarter basis, revenue recorded a sharp 78.54% increase compared to the quarter 2 of the financial year '26. The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 FY26 EBITDA margin expanded by 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in Q3 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Basic raw material prices have not shown any significant changes over the past 2 years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: During the first two months of manufacturing (November and December), the plant utilized around 60% of its capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to reduce debt completely using strong internal cash flow generation.
capital_allocation.quote: No, plan is to reduce 100%. So right now, the maximum requirement of our capex we have done, you know the manufacturing unit is already working. So now focus is on reducing debt also for our company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: New machinery will be added over the next couple of months to expand the product portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

management_commitments.claim: Non-textile binder and glue products trial results and intimations will be shared within a couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So, hopefully we will be coming soon within couple of months, we will intimate to you once again when we will get through.

management_commitments.claim: New products may be launched within 3 to 4 months following ongoing R&D work.
management_commitments.quote: Since sorry to interrupt, our R&D is also going on, so maybe within 3-4 months we can launch some new products also, so we may expand little bit with the capacity of the vessels also.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to selectively expand market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic wood coating segment.
management_commitments.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve full capacity utilization of the Vadodara manufacturing plant by the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: Within the next 1 to 2 years, trading and manufacturing revenues are expected to be equal at 50% each.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, that is the question which I am looking that you will you may ask some questions like this. Anyway, but in coming years our trading and manufacturing we are expecting that it would be equal. Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
